env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
cp o3key/stackbuf.go o0key/stackbuf.go
cp o3key/stackbuf_test.go o0key/stackbuf_test.go

cd o3key
env WANT_STACKBUF=4096
logos test -count=1 .
stdout '^ok'
logos test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
! logos test -count=1 -O=0 .
stdout 'FAIL'
env WANT_STACKBUF=32
logos test -count=1 -O=0 .
stdout '^ok'
! logos test -count=1 .
stdout 'FAIL'
cd ..

cd o0key
env WANT_STACKBUF=32
logos test -count=1 .
stdout '^ok'
logos test -count=1 -O=0 .
stdout '^ok'
! logos test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout 'FAIL'
env WANT_STACKBUF=4096
logos test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
! logos test -count=1 .
stdout 'FAIL'
cd ..

-- o3key/go.mod --
module example.com/optflag/o3key

go 1.27

-- o3key/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O3"
arena = false

-- o3key/stackbuf.go --
package stackbuf

-- o3key/stackbuf_test.go --
package stackbuf

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

//go:noinline
func probe(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 1
	return b[n-1]
}

func heapFree(n int) bool {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = probe(n) }) == 0
}

func TestCompiledStackBuffer(t *testing.T) {
	want, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	if err != nil || want < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("WANT_STACKBUF=%q: want a byte count of at least 2", os.Getenv("WANT_STACKBUF"))
	}
	if !heapFree(want) {
		t.Errorf("make of %d bytes reached the heap, want it inside the frame", want)
	}
	if heapFree(want + 1) {
		t.Errorf("make of %d bytes stayed inside the frame, want the heap", want+1)
	}
}

-- o0key/go.mod --
module example.com/optflag/o0key

go 1.27

-- o0key/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O0"
arena = false
